- Wednesday: 15:00-16:00 (can book 15:00 or 15:30)
- Thursday: 10:00-10:30 (can book 10:00), 14:30-15:00 (can book 14:30)

Brad, please check Elena Soto and David Okafor's calendars and let me know which of these slots (or any other slots) work for both of them. Then we can pick a time and I'll create the booking.
